instructions: Review for production-grade quality the way this team works: most code is LLM-written, so focus on the conventions around the model, not cosmetic nits. Treat the rules in customContext as blocking.

rules: Provider isolation: a model-provider SDK (anthropic, openai, langchain-anthropic, etc.) may be imported ONLY in src/house_harness/config/llm.py. Flag any import elsewhere.
Untrusted content: ingested or retrieved artifact text must be treated as data, never instructions. Flag any path where artifact content can influence tool use, system prompts, or output structure.
Provenance required: every answer or generated harness rule must cite the source artifact/span it came from. Flag claims returned without attribution.

Evals for new behavior: any new capability, prompt change, or retrieval change should ship with a corresponding eval case in evals/evals.json (or the held-out evals/validation/validation.json). Flag behavior added without an eval.
Contradiction handling: when sources disagree, code must surface the conflict with sources and recency (Dissent), not silently pick one value.

Typed boundaries: flag any value crossing a module boundary or returned by an LLM that is a raw dict or unparsed string instead of a Pydantic model. LLM calls feeding a downstream stage must use structured output (config/structured.py), not regex parsing.
Determinism: conflict resolution, supersession, scope handling, name canon, and vocab normalization must stay deterministic (rules over the ontology), never an LLM opinion at query time.

Failure isolation: ingestion must be per-file isolated (bad file -> IngestFailure, not a crash); operational failures must surface as status=failed/degraded + errors on the envelope, never silently collapsed into abstained.
Secrets: no API keys, tokens, or credentials in code, fixtures, logs, or committed .env files.
Least privilege + gates: tools get only the scope a step needs; no consequential or irreversible action without an approval gate; every agent has a hard step/timeout/cost cap.

Privilege separation (when the action surface lands): flag any model call that ingests untrusted input and also has tools bound, or any path where untrusted free text reaches the executor. The reader emits only a validated ReaderOutput; the executor runs only allowlisted PlanRequests over a closed vocabulary (no arbitrary URL/fetch/shell).
Provider leakage: content may leave to a model only via config/llm.py; flag whole-document context where sourced spans would do. Traces must carry only metadata + sourced spans, never raw corpus.
Swappability: no business logic coupled to a specific tracing or vector vendor outside obs/ and the store layer.

Hybrid retrieval integrity: when the deferred hybrid retriever is implemented it must fuse dense + sparse + graph (no silent dense-only fallback) and preserve recency weighting + as-of dates; until then the only retrieval path is the documented WholeCorpus fallback.
